mapper.insert: insert into note_file ( note_no, attach_no, note_file_ctime ) values ( #{noteNo}, #{attachNo}, systimestamp )
mapper.select: select a.attach_no as attachNo, a.attach_name as attachName, a.attach_type as attachType, a.attach_size as attachSize, nf.note_file_ctime as ctime from note_file nf inner join attach a on nf.attach_no = a.attach_no where nf.note_no = #{noteNo} order by nf.note_file_ctime asc
mapper.insert: insert into note_comment_file ( note_comment_no, attach_no, note_comment_file_ctime ) values ( #{noteCommentNo}, #{attachNo}, systimestamp )
mapper.select: select a.attach_no as attachNo, a.attach_name as attachName, a.attach_type as attachType, a.attach_size as attachSize, ncf.note_comment_file_ctime as ctime from note_comment_file ncf inner join attach a on ncf.attach_no = a.attach_no where ncf.note_comment_no = #{noteCommentNo} order by ncf.note_comment_file_ctime asc
